metadata.provenance: PENDING DFT/NEB WORKLIST. No computed energies or attempt frequencies have been supplied. Charges are requested branches, not established stable charge states.
metadata.energy_reference: Common arbitrary classical-energy reference within each fixed charge branch; saddle_eV is absolute on that reference. Different q branches are not thermodynamically compared.
metadata.prefactor_convention: One equal forward/reverse attempt_Hz per charge/channel; unequal HTST prefactors are unsupported.
metadata.charge_selection: Requested independent fixed-charge branches; no charge-state population or electron capture model.
metadata.channel_reduction: Translation and reverse equivalence only; no full space-group reduction is claimed.

structure.provenance: Pathak et al. 2020 combined experimental refinement; idealized Hf occupancy; not DFT-relaxed. DOI:10.1107/S2053229620013960
